name: Pomerado
long_description:
Pomerado turns any website into an API / MCP in minutes. Empower your agents to use previously inaccessable consumer websites, legacy portals, and internal tools. 

You or your agent describe a task, Pomerado asks a few clarifying questions, and then delivers an integration. We manage hosting, permissioning, testing, and maintenance, so you can focus on building. 

Customers can use us to:
    • automate back office workflows on legacy systems (ERP, EHR, CRM)
    • speed up customer integrations for forward deployments
    • connect enterprise assistants to internal tools
    • supercharge personal assistants with fast and reliable browser use

We’re ex-McKinsey and Scale AI. While driving F500 enterprise agent deployments, we saw that legacy systems were the true blocker to agentic workflows. Pomerado connects those systems to agents.
one_liner: Turn any website into an MCP for your agents, in minutes
